p-conversations.title: Conversations Archive
p-conversations.services: Editorial curation, interviews, editing, layout and talent coordination
p-conversations.desc: Conversations Archive is a series of long-form interviews with designers and artists working at the edges of the fashion system. Developed and edited by Cyana-Djoher Hadjali, the project treats the interview as primary material: a way to document creative positions and working methods as they emerge. For Newcoin Research Center, the series extended internationally through conversations with Tomikono Wigg, Louisa Gagliardi, Vitalii Akiniov and J.Kim. The work included editorial coordination, layouts and talent submissions across fashion, art and Web3.

p-middaia.title: Middaia: Wholesale development
p-middaia.services: Market positioning, wholesale strategy, buyer outreach, retailer negotiation, press and event support
p-middaia.desc: C19 leads wholesale development for Middaia, the independent label founded by Jade Nguyen Van. The work connects market positioning with seasonal wholesale strategy, buyer outreach and retailer negotiation, including development toward the Asian market. Press materials and outreach for trunk shows support the wider programme. The aim is to build a distribution network that fits the label's identity and pace of growth.

p-enami.title: ENAMI: Brand development and wholesale
p-enami.services: Brand management, positioning, product architecture, wholesale strategy and buyer-facing materials
p-enami.desc: C19 works with ENAMI as an embedded brand development and wholesale partner. The work spans positioning, brand structure, product architecture and the buyer-facing materials needed to bring the label to market. Wholesale is treated as part of the brand's expression, connecting its identity with the retailers and audiences it wants to reach.

p-form.title: FORM: Fashion archive and Academy
p-form.services: Archive development, research, editorial direction and video hosting
p-form.desc: As Archive Lead at FORM, Cyana-Djoher Hadjali contributes to the development of a fashion archive platform, sourcing, structuring and narrating designer histories. She also hosts FORM Academy, a video series on fashion designers drawn from her doctoral research. Each episode combines biographical analysis with close readings of collections and runway shows.

p-acne.title: Acne Studios SS27: VIP and guest coordination
p-acne.services: VIP and celebrity coordination, event production, guest experience and show operations
p-acne.desc: C19 supported Acne Studios' Spring/Summer 2027 (SS27) Paris Fashion Week show through VIP and celebrity guest coordination, including transfers, hair and make-up scheduling, fittings, welcome packs, hospitality and show-day arrivals. This latest engagement builds on a longer relationship with the house. From 2022 to 2023, Cyana-Djoher Hadjali worked within the Events & Projects department, contributing to event production from sourcing through breakdown, budget tracking, call sheets, schedules, the Spring/Summer 2023 show and front-of-house operations. She also coordinated the press trip to Kero AB in Pajala and Stockholm for the launch of the Acne Studios Kero Boots.

p-messika.title: Messika: Press and guest relations
p-messika.services: Press relations, guest list management, invitation logistics and show-day coordination
p-messika.desc: C19 joined the press and public relations team for Messika's Paris Fashion Week show. The work included guest list management, invitation logistics, calligraphy coordination, seating plan support, photographer accreditation, press check-ins and live liaison with public relations teams and media on show day.

p-puig-creo.title: PUIG Creative Hub: Editorial and cultural content
p-puig-creo.services: Editorial strategy, French and English copywriting, content curation and visual coordination
p-puig-creo.desc: C19 develops editorial copy and curates web content for the PUIG Creative Hub in French and English. The work spans fragrance and beauty storytelling, city and cultural guides, trend-focused content, and coordination of copy and visual materials across the group's cultural programming.

p-carhartt.title: Carhartt WIP: Editorial and product copy
p-carhartt.services: Creative writing and French product copywriting
p-carhartt.desc: C19's work with Carhartt WIP has included creative writing for WIP.08 and French product copy for the 2026 seasonal range. The copy translates technical garment information into precise French while staying true to the brand's established voice.

p-cartier.title: Harper's Bazaar Turkey × Cartier: Cover shoot production
p-cartier.desc: C19 coordinated production and project management for a Harper's Bazaar Turkey × Cartier cover shoot in Paris. The work included talent, location and logistics coordination, alongside on-set operations for an international editorial team.

p-ashaalia.title: Ashaalia: Creative direction and wholesale strategy
p-ashaalia.services: Brand audit, positioning, creative direction, product copy, e-commerce structure and wholesale development
p-ashaalia.desc: C19 supports Ashaalia across brand strategy, creative direction and wholesale development. The work includes a brand audit and positioning, product language and copy guidelines, e-commerce structure and wholesale outreach. Together, these elements build a clearer narrative and the practical infrastructure needed to present the brand to customers and buyers.

p-palladium.title: Palladium SS22: 'Ticket to Earth'
p-palladium.desc: C19 contributed creative writing and voice-over to Palladium's Spring/Summer 2022 campaign, 'Ticket to Earth', created for the brand's 75th anniversary.

p-newcoin.title: Newcoin Research Center: Editorial strategy
p-newcoin.services: Cultural trend analysis, editorial strategy, interviews, layout and narrative direction
p-newcoin.desc: At Newcoin Research Center, Cyana-Djoher Hadjali worked on cultural trend analysis and editorial strategy at the intersection of fashion, aesthetics and Web3. The role included interviews with international designers and artists, editorial layouts and narrative direction.

p-premiercri.title: BADSEKI: Brand development and cultural programming
p-premiercri.services: Brand development, digital direction, social strategy, art direction, copywriting and event production
p-premiercri.desc: C19 supported BADSEKI's brand development through website development, social media strategy, art direction and copywriting. The work also included the organisation of launch events, screenings and concert evenings, connecting the brand's digital presence with a programme of live cultural activity.

p-unhome.title: UNHOME, Paris edition: Manifesto and retail experience
p-unhome.services: Cultural research, manifesto writing, editorial development, invitations and guest coordination
p-unhome.desc: For UNHOME's Paris edition, C19 developed research and writing for a nomadic design retail concept, including a manifesto that frames design through the idea of the real home. The work also included invitations and guest coordination, bringing the project's ideas into the event experience.

services.name: Cultural mapping and intelligence
services.desc: Research into the cultural forces, subcultures, behaviours, aesthetics and technologies shaping a field. C19 maps references and relationships to help teams recognise where change is happening and what it could mean for their brand, product or audience.

services.name: Strategic positioning and brand architecture
services.desc: A clear position built from a precise understanding of the brand and its context. C19 helps define what a brand stands for, where it belongs, who it speaks to and how it can remain distinctive as its market changes.

services.name: Brand narrative and world-building
services.desc: The ideas, language and reference systems that give a brand a coherent world. C19 develops narrative architecture, creative platforms, verbal direction and cultural frameworks that teams can carry across products, campaigns, content and experiences.

services.name: Creative direction, archives and iconography
services.desc: Visual research and creative direction for campaigns, editorials, publications and brand experiences. Archival research, image analysis and carefully built reference systems connect a creative idea to the histories and visual codes it draws on.

services.name: Fashion brand and market development
services.desc: Strategic and commercial support for fashion brands, from product architecture and pricing to wholesale strategy, linesheets, brand materials and buyer-facing narratives. C19 connects how a brand is understood culturally with how it is presented to the market.

services.name: Editorial research and writing
services.desc: Research-led writing and content development for brands, publications and cultural organisations. This includes interviews, long-form writing, editorial strategy, research dossiers, presentations, copywriting and cultural storytelling.

services.name: Artist and cultural collaborations
services.desc: C19 works with artists, designers and independent cultural practitioners on projects that bring research, writing and creative practice together. Each collaboration is shaped around the practitioner, the work and the context in which it will be encountered.

services.name: Production and guest experience
services.desc: Practical coordination for fashion shows, events and editorial productions, including guest and press relations, VIP coordination, fittings, schedules, logistics and show-day operations. This is an execution capability within the wider practice.

writing.title: Nietzsche's Shadow in Ecological Thought
writing.summary: This essay traces Nietzsche's shadow across ecological thought, reading post-apocalyptic science fiction as a laboratory where the genealogy of morality is re-run under conditions of collapse, and where a future ethics is constructed from the ruins of the present one.

writing.title: 032c: Sara Choi
writing.summary: A conversation with professional drifter Sara Choi for 032c.

writing.title: Grills: Smiling at the System
writing.summary: Published in Cara Magazine's Mouth issue, this bilingual essay traces the history of dental adornment, from Mayan gemstone inlays to Eddie Plein's custom grillz, reading grills through Barthes' fashion system as ornaments that politicise the mouth: part jewellery, part armour, a smile turned against the codes of dominant beauty.

writing.title: FERAL: Selected Writings
writing.summary: Founder and editor-in-chief. An independent editorial platform publishing essays, interviews and reflections that move between fashion, philosophy, images, technology and contemporary life.

writing.title: Material Memories and Internal Ecologies: Reconnecting Fashion to Cultural Continuity Through Boro in High Fashion
writing.venue: 28th IFFTI Annual Conference, RMIT Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City
writing.summary: Conference paper reading boro as material memory and a form of cultural continuity within high fashion.

writing.title: Transparent Garments and Image-Clothing: On the Digitalization of Fashion and the Loss of Enclothed Knowledge
writing.venue: 16th International Conference on the Image, Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne. Selected as Emerging Scholar
writing.summary: Conference paper on the digitalisation of fashion, transparent garments and the loss of enclothed knowledge.

writing.title: The Revival of the Japanese Technique of Boro in High Fashion: Mending, Materiality, and the Ecology of Repair
writing.venue: CIMAD, International Conference on Art and Design Practices, Saint-Étienne and Lyon. Proceedings forthcoming
writing.summary: Conference paper on boro, mending, materiality and the ecology of repair in high fashion.

writing.title: Rebuilding Fashion through Subversion: Punk, Grunge, and Politics of Deconstruction in Luxury Ready-to-Wear
writing.venue: Nouvelles Gestualités Dissidentes symposium, ENSAD Limoges and Université Paris 1
writing.summary: Symposium paper on punk, grunge and the politics of deconstruction in luxury ready-to-wear.

writing.title: Gestures and Temporalities of Fashion
writing.venue: Study day at Institut Français de la Mode, co-organised with Jeanne-Léopoldine Claustre and Estelle Dupuis
writing.summary: A co-organised study day bringing together designers, archivists, and researchers to examine how the fashion gesture is repeated, transmitted, and altered over time.

writing.title: On the Sustainability of the Fashion Design Gesture
writing.venue: Doctoral research, Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and Università di Bologna, under Barbara Formis and Stefano Marino. IFM Doctoral Research Programme
writing.summary: Ongoing doctoral research investigating ecological aesthetics, anti-fashion, material cultures and the structure of the fashion system in the Anthropocene.

site.heroHeadline: C19 Consulting is a Paris-based cultural strategy practice working across fashion, luxury, beauty, technology and culture.
site.quote: Cultural strategy, intelligence and world-building for brands shaping what comes next.
site.selectedWorkIntro: A selection of strategy, research, editorial and production projects across fashion, beauty, design and culture.
site.servicesPreviewCopy: C19 connects cultural intelligence to decisions brands can act on. The work includes cultural mapping, strategic positioning, brand narrative, creative direction, archival and iconographic research, editorial development and fashion business strategy. Projects can begin with a question about culture or identity and develop into a clear framework, creative platform or practical plan.
site.collaborationLine: C19 works with brands, artists, designers and cultural organisations, bringing research and creative thinking into dialogue with the people making culture.
site.closingCTA: Have a project, question or collaboration in mind?
site.aboutIntro: A cultural strategy practice between research and practice. Paris / Tokyo.
site.aboutPara1: C19 Consulting works with brands, organisations and creative practitioners to understand the worlds they operate in and the worlds they want to create.
site.aboutPara2: Founded by Cyana-Djoher Hadjali, C19 brings cultural research, systems thinking, strategic positioning and creative direction together. The work begins with close attention to context: the histories, images, behaviours, technologies and subcultural movements shaping a field. C19 then helps clients clarify their point of view and translate it into a coherent brand narrative, identity or direction.
site.aboutPara3: The practice is grounded in fashion, luxury, beauty and visual culture, with a clear focus on technology, platform architecture and the cultural systems forming around them. Its work moves between long-term thinking and practical decisions, from defining a position to shaping how it is expressed through a brand, collection, campaign, publication or experience.
site.aboutPara4: C19 also works with artists, designers and independent cultural practitioners on research, writing, editorial and creative projects. These collaborations sit alongside client commissions and contribute to an ongoing exchange between practice and culture.
site.founderPara1: Cyana-Djoher Hadjali is a researcher and strategist working across fashion, aesthetics and cultural practice. She has extensive experience in fashion and beauty, alongside work in editorial research, archives, creative direction, brand development and fashion production.
site.founderPara2: Her academic training spans contemporary philosophy, visual cultures and management, with graduate studies at École normale supérieure (ENS), EHESS and HEC Paris. She is a PhD candidate in aesthetics and fashion theory at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and the University of Bologna, and participates in the Institut Français de la Mode's Doctoral Research Programme.
site.founderPara3: Her research informs C19's approach to cultural mapping, material histories, image-making and the systems through which fashion acquires meaning. It gives the practice a strong theoretical foundation while keeping its recommendations connected to the decisions creative and commercial teams need to make.
site.howWorksHeading: From cultural signals to clear direction
site.howWorksPara1: C19 approaches each brief as a connected system. A brand's position is shaped by its history, products, audiences, images, language, channels and relationships to wider culture. The work maps those connections, identifies what is changing and develops a point of view the organisation can use.
site.howWorksPara2: Depending on the brief, the process may include archival and iconographic research, interviews, cultural and market mapping, strategic workshops, narrative development, creative direction or practical implementation. The scope is shaped around the question, with research translated into clear recommendations and usable materials.
site.workIntro: C19 works across strategy, research, creative direction, editorial and production. Each project starts with a specific cultural or organisational question and develops a response suited to its context, from a brand position or archive to a market plan, publication or live experience.
site.writingIntro: Writing and research are central to C19's practice. This work brings philosophical inquiry into contact with fashion, images, materials, technologies and contemporary culture. It includes commissioned editorial projects, interviews, independent writing and academic research.
site.infoClosingLine: For consulting, editorial and creative collaborations, contact cyana@c19consulting.com.
